pulse.text: **GPT-5.6's public-launch clock tightened this sweep**: Polymarket's modal ship date firmed to **July 9 at ~74%** (up from ~64% twelve hours ago), even as OpenAI's three-tier Sol/Terra/Luna suite stays gated to ~20 government-vetted partners pending a White House standards framework. Otherwise a **quiet stretch — no new model and no ranking change**: Anthropic's **Claude Fable 5 still leads the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 60** (v4.1), ahead of its own Opus 4.8 (56) and OpenAI's GPT-5.5 (55), with **Gemini 3.5 Pro holding its July 17 GA target**. The smaller drift is commercial — **Fable 5's free ride in Pro/Max/Team plans ended July 7**, reverting to $10/$50 metered credits. In infrastructure, CNBC reports **Nvidia's Kyber rack system slipped to 2028** on manufacturing snags (Nvidia insists its roadmap is intact), while **Microsoft leans harder on its own MAI models** in Office to trim OpenAI/Anthropic costs. Watch next: whether GPT-5.6 actually opens to the public on the 9th.
